    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架2025年11月简报</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">

<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>公众号每月定期推广和分享的C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架（每周至少会推荐两个优秀的项目和框架当然节假日除外），公众号推文中有项目和框架的详细介绍、功能特点、使用方式以及部分功能截图等（打不开或者打开GitHub很慢的同学可以优先查看公众号推文，文末一定会附带项目和框架源码地址）。注意：排名不分先后，都是十分优秀的开源项目和框架，每周定期更新分享<span>。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>💡简报Gitee开源地址：<a href="https://gitee.com/ysgdaydayup/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/ysgdaydayup/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</a></strong></li>
<li><strong>🔔简报GitHub开源地址：<a href="https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide/blob/main/docs/DotNet/DotNetProjectMonthly.md</a></strong></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>STNodeEditor</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;STNodeEditor 是一款基于 .NET WinForm 开源免费（MIT License）、轻量且功能强大的节点编辑器，采用纯 GDI+ 绘制无任何依赖库仅仅100+Kb，提供了丰富的属性以及事件，可以非常方便的完成节点之间数据的交互及通知，编辑器内置了大量虚函数，供开发者根据需求进行重写，赋予了极高的自由度和定制能力。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/DebugST/STNodeEditor" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/DebugST/STNodeEditor</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517917&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=b496b099cc94be01d2cfc01f175a0b02&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/fMG3iAu1Y0Fkmf6d-fcgiA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202511/1336199-20251103223031860-350439270.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223851885-59703445.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>WenAntdUI-Admin</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;WenAntdUI-Admin 是一个基于 AntdUI 构建、基础、现代化的 WinForm 管理系统，基于 Apache-2.0 License 开源，项目包含：AOT发布、字典管理、用户管理、菜单管理、权限管理、用户设置等功能。内部封装了很多常用组件，包含AdminTable等通用组件。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://gitee.com/AntdUI/wen-antd-ui" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/AntdUI/wen-antd-ui</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518260&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=9ad59f14f66cdbdb42e93c2539bf30ef&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/VTBcoZZ2mNyuyV_s4fzsPA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223904984-430321389.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223909878-669897489.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>NetCoreKevin</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;NetCoreKevin 是一个基于 .NET 8 + DDD 搭建的模块化微服务框架，其模块化设计使得每个功能都可以独立引用，非常适合大型企业级应用的开发。框架支持IdentityServer4<span>单点登录、多缓存、自动任务、分布式、一库多租户、日志、授权和鉴权、CAP集成事件、SignalR、领域事件、ESL、<span>MCP协议服务、IOC模块化注入、Cors、Quartz自动任务、多短信集成、AI智能体、AI 集成 <span>SemanticKernel、MCP 服务、OCR验证码识别、API多版本兼容、单元集成测试。</span></span></span></span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518101&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=b61c707faa85b343cbb77db3a7463c20&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/xGM9SLna-ihK1Qe228TRFQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223925242-465742201.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223932298-1099243070.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>ImageSearch</span></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;ImageSearch 是一个基于 .NET WPF 开源、免费（MIT license）、轻量的本地硬盘千万级图库以图搜图小工具，该项目灵感来源于市面上的重复文件、目录查找与清理的系统工具 DuplicateCleaner。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/ldqk/ImageSearch" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ldqk/ImageSearch</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518201&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=8fc73959afb99a78aacfa963751faf11&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/iRDW0KvDDBT5x9lotbR_2Q</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201223958810-1180959322.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>better-genshin-impact</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;better-genshin-impact 是一款基于 .NET + 计算机视觉技术完全开源免费（GPL-3.0 license）、功能强大的原神智能辅助自动化工具，意图让原神变的更好的项目，包含：自动剧情、全自动钓鱼(AI)、全自动七圣召唤、自动伐木、自动刷本、自动采集/挖矿/锄地等功能。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/babalae/better-genshin-impact" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/babalae/better-genshin-impact</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518390&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=2c49b88436d3ed42de1dcd3a2f6a0446&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/wZ4d9baOO2RXsb6VCdSxHQ</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224012795-872207564.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224018124-1123336931.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>DataGridFilter</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;DataGridFilter 是一款开源（<span>MIT License）、多语言的 WPF 可筛选 DataGrid 控件，旨在通过轻量级集成帮助开发者快速构建高效、灵活的数据展示管理界面。</span></span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/macgile/DataGridFilter" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/macgile/DataGridFilter</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518606&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=6226a1cee8f5abd50bfa0a7c327a664b&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/zrU7sivEvJrU090TF6TN3w</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224030500-1830201211.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224035369-1050438192.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Microsoft Agent Framework</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Microsoft Agent Framework 是一个面向 .NET 和 Python 的开源开发套件，用于构建 AI 智能体及多智能体工作流。它融合并扩展了 Semantic Kernel 与 AutoGen 项目的核心理念，在结合两者优势的基础上，进一步引入了全新能力。该框架由原班团队打造，将成为未来构建 AI 智能体的统一基础平台。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518651&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ce731e171187adf62a478a037886c384&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/qxjUYO2U-TCTd0JmEtbehA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224050792-1014883816.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224055742-826586787.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>AutoGen</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;AutoGen 是一个开源编程框架，它通过多个代理进行对话以解决任务，从而实现 <span>LLM 应用的开发。AutoGen 代理可定制、可对话，并且能够无缝地允许人类参与。它们可以在不同的模式下运行，使用 LLM、人类输入和工具的组合。</span></span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/autogen" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/microsoft/autogen</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518651&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ce731e171187adf62a478a037886c384&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/qxjUYO2U-TCTd0JmEtbehA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224108932-1332829166.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224114520-796722457.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Kernel Memory</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;Kernel Memory（KM）是一种多模态AI服务，RAG 架构，使用 LLM 和自然语言索引和查询任何数据、跟踪来源、显示引用、异步内存模式。该存储库提供了特定 AI 和 LLMs 应用场景中内存的最佳实践和参考架构。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/microsoft/kernel-memory" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/microsoft/kernel-memory</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518651&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ce731e171187adf62a478a037886c384&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/qxjUYO2U-TCTd0JmEtbehA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224130774-265509092.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224136110-329467756.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>AntSK</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;AntSK 是一个基于 .NET 9 和 Blazor 技术栈构建的企业级AI知识库和智能体平台，集成了 Semantic Kernel 和 Kernel Memory，提供完整的AI应用开发解决方案。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/AIDotNet/AntSK" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/AIDotNet/AntSK</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518651&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ce731e171187adf62a478a037886c384&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/qxjUYO2U-TCTd0JmEtbehA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224201825-766193717.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224207204-1445722378.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>OllamaSharp</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;OllamaSharp 旨在通过提供.NET绑定，使得开发者能够轻松地在.NET应用程序中使用Ollama API。简化了 .NET 与 Ollama 的本地和远程交互。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/awaescher/OllamaSharp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/awaescher/OllamaSharp</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247518651&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=ce731e171187adf62a478a037886c384&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/qxjUYO2U-TCTd0JmEtbehA</a></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202512/1336199-20251201224222408-925597913.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>WPFUIDemo</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>项目简介：</strong><span>&nbsp;WPFUIDemo 是一个专注于 WPF（Windows Presentation Foundation）用户界面设计与开发的示例项目。该项目旨在为开发者提供一个全面、实用的参考范例，帮助他们快速掌握 WPF 应用开发的核心技巧和最佳实践，提升开发效率与界面设计水平。通过丰富的功能模块和代码示例，开发者可以深入了解 WPF 的强大特性，并将其灵活应用于实际项目中。</span></li>
<li><strong>项目源码地址：</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://gitee.com/zhang-sleepyhead/WPFUIDemo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/zhang-sleepyhead/WPFUIDemo</a></li>
<li><strong>项目详细介绍：</strong><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxMTUzNzM5Ng==&amp;mid=2247517937&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=cae994d25ece27519e424f241a04f2d2&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/15oTrGmLzGl4AAUV6maIgw</a></span></li>
</ul>
